_README: HOW TO MAP THIS FORM (edit this file, no code changes needed):
zendesk_prefill — per question id, where the answer is auto-filled from. Sources:
agent.email | agent.name | agent.first | requester.email | requester.name |
requester.first | ticket.id | ticket.url | ticket.subject |
field:<zendesk custom field id>   (e.g. field:1215565058346606)
template:...{token}...            (any of the above tokens in braces, e.g.
'template:{agent.first} - {ticket.subject}')
Empty string = no prefill; the agent types the value.
asana_custom_fields — per question id, the GID of the Asana custom field on the
target project that should receive the answer. Empty = the answer only goes
into the task description (every answer is ALWAYS written to the description,
exactly like an Asana form submission). Find GIDs: open the project ->
Customize -> Fields, or GET /projects/<project_gid>/custom_field_settings.
Dropdown answers are matched to the Asana field's enum options BY NAME
(case-insensitive); if a name differs between the form and the field, add an
explicit pair to enum_value_map below.
enum_value_map — optional: form option id -> Asana enum_option GID, for when
option names don't match between this config and the Asana custom field.
form.project_gid — the Asana project the created task lands in.
form.ticket_id_custom_field_gid — if set, the created task also gets this
custom field = the Zendesk ticket id, so it shows up in the 'Asana tasks'
pane. Cleared/skipped automatically if the project doesn't have the field.
questions — generated from the live Asana form; ids are the form's own stable
ids. Re-run tools/gen_form_config.py to refresh after the form changes
(your mappings above are preserved).

questions.label: What level of urgency should this task be completed with?
questions.help:
Normal: 2 business days
Urgent: 1 business day

Note: For a task to meet Urgent criteria, one or more of the following must be true:
    The provider indicates clear churn risk
    Continuity of care is being disrupted (e.g., provider cannot deliver care/client cannot receive care due to a blocker on Alma’s end)

fields.label: Does this request need to be completed on the same day?
fields.help:
Note: Only select this field if your request meets the criteria for same-day completion. 
Examples:
    A session scheduled for today is directly impacted and/or cannot proceed
    A customer has been experiencing an ongoing issue that has resulted in a continuous blocker(s) and/or escalation 
        e.g., a portal bug has blocked a provider's claim submission ability for 2+ weeks, resulting in care being paused, severe ongoing escalation

Otherwise, do not select any option from this drop-down.

fields.label: What help do you need from the Marketing Team?
fields.help:
The Marketing team helps Alma grow. The team is composed of four sub-teams, listed below. CX support questions are fielded by our Senior Manager of Brand Marketing as most of them are brand-related inquiries.

Consumer Growth - brings clients to Alma.

Demand Generation - supports the Growth team in building awareness among prospective clinicians.

Lifecycle and Product Marketing - improves and educates on Alma's member experience.

Brand - improves awareness of Alma for all audiences; includes social media, awareness (not clinical) partnerships, PR, and written content.

options.label: External - press, marketing, or partnership opportunity

fields.label: What help do you need from the Community Team?
fields.help:
The Community Team is responsible for building and supporting the Alma provider community. They are the main moderators in the Community Hub, support the Continued Education Courses (CEs) offering, and plan Alma provider events.

For more information on Continuing Education courses and which providers are eligible for credits, see the https://app.getguru.com/boards/ckenAGki/Continuing-Education.

You can find a list of all Alma Events https://events.helloalma.com/. Note that individual events will confirm if the event will be recorded.

fields.label: Has the provider been paid for any visits yet?
fields.help:
Read before continuing:
Check to see if there is a date under "Paid Provider On" in the Alma Portal. If so, the provider was paid for that particular session.

If Yes, we will deduct the payment from the provider.
If No, they will not be paid for this visit as it will be canceled.

Please communicate the above to the provider, as CAT will not send a Zendesk ticket.

fields.label: Please list the DOS status so we know what is and is not yet back from the insurance company.

CAT will take action on what they can now and will wait to take action on what has not yet returned. Please communicate this with the provider.
